entries.label: sum
entries.description: SAMA summer block — square containing the Greek letter sigma (Σ); algebraic sum of two or more input signals.

entries.label: gain
entries.description: SAMA gain (proportional) block — square containing 'K' or a slope-line icon; multiplies the input by a constant.

entries.label: lag
entries.description: SAMA first-order lag block — square with a rising exponential-approach curve; first-order time filter.

entries.label: lead_lag
entries.description: SAMA lead-lag block — square with an overshoot-then-decay curve; dynamic compensation for feed-forward loops.

entries.label: integrator
entries.description: SAMA integrator block — square containing an integral sign (∫) or a rising ramp icon; accumulates the input over time.

entries.label: derivative
entries.description: SAMA derivative block — square containing 'd/dt' or a spike icon; outputs the rate of change of the input.

entries.label: pid_controller
entries.description: SAMA PID controller block — square (or stacked rectangles) labeled P+I+D or with separate proportional/integral/derivative icons; closed-loop regulator.

entries.label: bias
entries.description: SAMA bias block — square containing '+/-' or 'B'; adds a constant offset to the input signal.

entries.label: limit
entries.description: SAMA limiter block — square with a clipped-ramp icon showing upper and lower bounds; clamps the output between set limits.

entries.label: selector_high
entries.description: SAMA high-signal selector block — square marked '>' or 'HS'; outputs the maximum of two or more input signals.

entries.label: selector_low
entries.description: SAMA low-signal selector block — square marked '<' or 'LS'; outputs the minimum of two or more input signals.

entries.label: selector_median
entries.description: SAMA median selector block — square marked 'MS' or with a middle-pick icon; outputs the median of three input signals.

entries.label: function_generator
entries.description: SAMA function generator block — square containing 'f(x)' or a piecewise curve; arbitrary single-input characterization.

entries.label: manual_station
entries.description: SAMA manual/auto station — square (often with A/M toggle) allowing operator to switch between automatic control output and manual output.

entries.label: transmitter
entries.description: SAMA transmitter block — circle with a 'T' or measured-variable letters; converts a field measurement into a signal entering the logic.

entries.label: signal_input
entries.description: SAMA signal input — small circle or arrow tag at the left edge of a diagram denoting an external signal entering the logic.

entries.label: signal_output
entries.description: SAMA signal output — small circle or arrow tag at the right edge of a diagram denoting a signal leaving the logic to a field device or another sheet.

notes: SAMA starter set — v0 stub for Phase 3 fallback per spec §7.2.2. Covers the core continuous-control block vocabulary: math operators (sum, gain, bias), dynamic elements (lag, lead_lag, integrator, derivative), the PID block, limiters and selectors (H/L/median), function generator, manual/auto station, and the signal I/O terminations. Discrete-logic (AND/OR/NOT, timers, counters) is intentionally omitted — those come from the logic-diagram extractor's custom schema, not this legend pack.
